items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Girlfriend I know, dancer, was in the show with 'Memories of Jolson.'

ctx.x: But when I saw her again at the whats'name), she got married again, guy goes buys her a car and going to do everything, so-and-

so. That's then, I'm going to New York, then I come to California. When I'm in California I'm here and I got the stroke. My friend is over on 35th Street somewhere. Girlfriend I know, dancer, was in the show with "Memories of Jolson." This girl was in the show "Memories of Jolson," which give me more key points on who was in that show -- God rest her soul, she passed away. And this girl -- my ex-wife come to see this girl, 'cause she was her friend, but the same guy choose the white girl to be my companion on the…

Like they put on pictures today, they get the most ugliest negro woman and find the most handsome negro man to match them up -- ugliest team in the world. Sad as McKinley's funeral. Understand what I'm saying? That's the way they do. They had a thing on the program last night about that. Two negros,
